title: Base Chain is Printing Millionaires - How to Get Started (Bridge & Airdrop)

Block explorer: https://basescan.org/

Dex: https://leetswap.finance/
https://dexscreener.com/base

Join my Telegram: https://t.me/prestitocrypto
Follow my Twitter: https://twitter.com/CryptoPrestito
Join my Telegram Announcements: https://t.me/prestitocryptoann

#basechain #crypto #eth #cryptocurrency #cryptonews #cryptoproject #cryptotrading #layer2
